candidate.role: high-capacity sparse quality-ceiling and possible teacher candidate

grow_doc_assessment.recommended_role: research-only quality-ceiling comparator after the current pinned Qwen3-8B base-vs-RAG experiment
advantages: sparse activation may provide substantially higher model capacity than the current 8B baseline while activating a much smaller subset per token
native multimodal support is potentially relevant to future plant-image diagnostic evaluation
long context can support retrieval-grounded document and citation workloads
blocking_requirements: freeze an exact model revision and tokenizer/processor revision
hash and review the exact prompt/chat-template contract
freeze deterministic non-reasoning and, if tested, reasoning decoding contracts separately
verify dependency versions and evaluator compatibility
establish a realistic hardware/VRAM/runtime contract for the 119B-weight footprint
bind the candidate to the same frozen heldout_v2 and RAG snapshot contract
run the same factuality, diagnostic, hallucination, citation-accuracy, science, education, grounded-QA, and regression slices
demonstrate measured improvement before any training-target or teacher promotion
grow_doc_assessment.decision: Do not replace Qwen3-8B or spend fine-tuning compute on this candidate yet. First complete the controlled Qwen3-8B base-only versus identical base-plus-frozen-RAG benchmark. Mistral Small 4 should then be evaluated only as a separately frozen research challenger.

supports: 119B total and approximately 6B active model parameters
